pois.name: Bow section
pois.note: Published position 41°43′57″N 49°56′49″W. depth_m is the scan target at roughly mid-hull height; GMRT seabed here is 3,802 m.

pois.name: Stern section
pois.note: Published position 41°43′35″N 49°56′54″W. GMRT seabed here is 3,801 m.

pois.name: Boiler field
pois.note: Centre of the boiler field, 41°43′32″N 49°56′49″W: the Wikipedia "Wreck of the Titanic" infobox coordinate, footnoted "the centre of the boiler field" (Ballard 1987, p. 199); titanicstory.com gives the same coordinate for the boilers. That puts it ~150 m south-east of the published stern position; Wikipedia says the boilers are about 600 ft (180 m) east of the stern.

pois.name: Debris field (mid-site)
pois.note: Representative point in the gap between the sections. The two dense debris fields are each 600–800 m long (about 5 km² together), and the 2010 survey mapped 15–20 sq mi (39–52 km²) of seafloor; neither extent is published as coordinates.

pois.name: Deck fittings and bollards
pois.note: Illustrative location in the mid-site debris; individual fittings are scattered through the field and their positions are not published.

pois.name: Where the "Big Piece" lay
pois.note: Approximate: hull plating that broke from the stern lies in the stern-side debris, which trails south-west from the stern (Wikipedia, 'Wreck of the Titanic', section 'Debris fields', citing Ballard 1987, p. 207). Placed ~175 m south-west of the stern. The Big Piece itself was raised in 1998 and is not on the seabed.

pois.name: Memorial plaque site (stern)
pois.note: Aft starboard corner of the stern section, where Ballard fixed the Titanic Historical Society plaque in July 1986. Exact placement is approximate; the plaque itself was gone by 1996 and is not modelled.

pois.name: Unnamed seabed channel
pois.note: Eastern flank of a shallow NNE–SSW channel visible in the GMRT tile, ~4.8 km north-west of the bow (seabed 3,871 m here, axis ~3,890 m). This is survey data, not a reconstruction.
